## Emiliano Rizza

PhD Researcher in Theoretical Physics  
Department of Theoretical Physics  
Jagiellonian University

I am completing my PhD in Theoretical Physics and am interested in research opportunities starting in 2027 across theoretical and mathematical physics, scientific R&D, quantum technologies and quantitative modelling.

I am particularly interested in problems involving quantum dynamics, spectral methods, mathematical modelling and complex systems, and I am open to both academic and research-oriented industry positions.
